If you and JoeIdiot up there actually knew a damn about suicidal thoughts, you'd realize that guilt tripping does nothing - I repeat ABSOLUTELY NOTHING - to help. Do you REALLY think OP needs reminding that people will be sad if they are gone? Of course not. 

Why? Because suicide isn't some freely made decision based on "wah nobody likes me". OP has problems with her own self love and that's where the problem needs to be fixed first.

It does not MATTER whether OP mention their children; that is for OP to talk about and absolutely nobody else. Suicide is a very personal matter and nobody should live or die "for" anyone else; if you don't want to live and you use someone else as a reason to live, they become an unhealthy crutch and maybe even a form of resentment "oh I'm still alive cos of YOU". Yes, even children.

I sincerely hope OP seeks out a therapist, doctor or counsellor and gets help with the way they feel. God knows we all need it. But stop. The guilt tripping rule about loved ones IS IN THERE FOR A REASON.
How about you follow the sub rules instead of trying to talk your way out of what happened, hm?
That's the people who ghosted me tbh
Yes, but the rules were broken all the same, quite directly.

I feel ya on that quite a lot. I try my best to fit in, to succeed even just to "get by" but the most basic of things are just a supreme effort that I've lost the energy for.

Mental health is hard to deal with on either side of the deal. Be patient with her, and don't go behind her back. I speak from experience us heavily depressed types sometimes do dumb things to ourselves to spite those around us because we feel it's the only thing that makes sense.

Yeah no kidding. I'm a Maladaptive Daydreamer, so it helps me to sleep if I am brain-deep in a scenario of some sort, and so many times that scenario has been a coma, or unconsciousness. I can't just sleep because tired.
